mechanism: Hydrocortisone may increase infection risk and mask infectious symptoms while piperacillin-tazobactam treats bacterial infections; corticosteroids can also reduce antibiotic efficacy in some contexts.
action: Monitor for adequate therapeutic response to piperacillin-tazobactam; ensure appropriate hydrocortisone dosing is justified and not masking treatment failure; consider clinical reassessment if infection does not improve.
